description: This file defines the DeadlockDetector class, which inspects thread and lock states within Android process snapshots to detect deadlocks caused by cyclic lock dependencies. It includes internal classes for thread and lock record management and a static method for performing deadlock detection analysis.

classes.name: DeadlockDetector
classes.description: A utility class that inspects process and thread snapshots to identify deadlocked threads due to cyclic lock dependencies.

inner_classes.name: ThreadRecord
inner_classes.description: Represents an involved thread, associating a ProcessSnapshot with a ThreadSnapshot, comparable for sorting and hashing.

inner_classes.name: LockRecord
inner_classes.description: Represents a lock held by a process's thread, with comparison and equality methods based on process and lock address.

methods.name: detectDeadlocks
methods.description: Main method to analyze VM traces for a given process ID and detect deadlocked threads arranged in lock cycles.

methods.name: addLockRecordsForThread
methods.description: Helper method to add all locks held by a specified thread in a process to the set of locks to visit during deadlock detection.
